name: Segway Ninebot MAX G3 E
facts: is part of Segway’s MAX G3 family, which Segway Australia lists with a maximum power of 2000 W and a theoretical range of 80 km

name: Segway Ninebot ZT3 Pro D
facts: is part of Segway’s ZT3 Pro family, which Segway Australia lists with a maximum power of 1600 W, a theoretical range of 70 km and 11-inch off-road tubeless tyres; the supplier’s listing adds front dual telescopic suspension, rear spring suspension and 152 mm of ground clearance

name: Segway Ninebot F3 Pro
facts: is listed by Segway Australia with a maximum power of 1200 W and a theoretical range of 70 km; the supplier’s listing adds front hydraulic and rear elastomer suspension and 10-inch tubeless self-sealing tyres

name: Segway Ninebot E2 Pro
facts: is listed by the supplier with a 275 Wh battery and up to 40 km of range in E mode at 15 km/h

name: Segway Ninebot C2 Pro
facts: is listed by the supplier for riders from 6 to 14 years old and 115 to 170 cm tall, with a 150 W motor and a 50 kg maximum rider weight

name: Gyroor H30 Max Kids Scooter
facts: is listed by the supplier with a 150 W motor, a 21.6V 2.6Ah battery, an electronic brake plus a foot brake, and a design for ages 6 to 12

name: Segway Ninebot Gokart Pro 2
facts: is listed by Segway Australia with a maximum speed of 43 km/h and a theoretical range of 25 km

name: Dragon GTR V2
facts: is listed by the supplier with a top speed of 50 km/h, two 900 W motors peaking at 2,400 W, a 21 Ah lithium battery, disc brakes and 10-inch tubeless all-terrain tyres

name: Dragon Raptor
facts: is listed by the supplier with a top speed of 62 km/h, two 1,000 W motors peaking at 3,600 W, a 20.3 Ah battery, dual disc brakes and a 2-year structure and frame warranty

name: Dragon Cyclone Pro
facts: is listed by the supplier with a top speed of 60 km/h, two 1,000 W motors peaking at 3,200 W, a 21 Ah lithium battery and fully hydraulic brakes

name: Dragon Slayer 22Ah
facts: is listed by the supplier with a top speed of 60 km/h, two 800 W motors peaking at 2,400 W, a 22 Ah battery (a 26 Ah version also exists) and dual hydraulic brakes
